As mediator of the Sinai covenant, Moses occupies a unique role: prophet, lawgiver, intercessor, and shepherd of a nation. The multilingual evidence — Spanish 'Mosheh,' French 'Moise,' German 'Mose' — shows universal recognition of this singular proper noun, with no semantic splitting across any language tradition."
